```yaml
name: Go CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    tags: ['*']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint & Drift Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go 1.26
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.26'
          cache: true

      - name: Install golangci-lint
        run: |
          curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golangci/golangci-lint/master/install.sh | sh -s -- -b $(go env GOPATH)/bin v1.61.0

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        run: golangci-lint run --config .golangci.yml

      - name: Run go vet
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Run go fix drift check
        run: |
          go fix ./...
          git diff --exit-code

      - name: Run govulncheck
        uses: golang/govulncheck-action@b625fbe08f3bccbe446d94fbf87fcc875a4f50ee
        with:
          go-version-input: '1.26'
          go-package: ./...
          work-dir: .
          output-format: json
          output-file: govulncheck.json

      - name: Upload govulncheck report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: govulncheck-report
          path: govulncheck.json

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go 1.26
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.26'
          cache: true

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/go-build
            ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then
            go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out
          else
            go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out -race
          fi

      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage
          path: coverage.out

      - name: Test Summary
        uses: test-summary/action@v2
        with:
          paths: coverage.out
          show: true
          folded: false

  autofix:
    name: Autofix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go 1.26
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.26'
          cache: true

      - name: Run autofix
        uses: autofix-ci/action@635ffb0c9798bd160680f18fd73371e355b85f27
        with:
          fail-fast: false
          commit-message: "chore: autofix formatting and lint"
          comment: "Autofix applied"
```
